overview: Prince Albert counted 37,756 residents in the 2021 Census, up 5.1 percent from 35,926 in 2016. The city has 14,308 occupied dwellings across 67.17 square kilometres on the North Saskatchewan River.

Healthcare and government jobs give the economy a stable base, and the city serves as the shopping and service centre for a large northern trading area. For a local business, that means competing for steady public-sector paycheques and for regional customers who drive in from surrounding communities.
